messages:
rachel: Heads-up: scheduling a set of 45m coaching huddles next week for three churn-risk accounts. Focus: unblock migration tasks, confirm model-version pin, and capture adoption commitments. Proposed windows: Mon 09:00 PT, Wed 12:30 PT, Thu 15:00 PT.

diego: I can take Mon 09:00 PT. happy to run the split demo + perf checklist (30/15).

jess: Wed 12:30 PT works. prefer we keep a small slide for rollback and who to ping.

omar: Thu 15:00 PT ok for me. I can own the follow-up action list and ensure AM gets any #renewal-risk flags.

rachel: Draft agenda: 1) 5m intros & desired outcome 2) 12m infra pre-check (VPC/KMS, routing) 3) 15m focused migration demo (model pinning, quant profile) 4) 5m quick rollback patterns 5) 8m actions & feedback.

felix: Suggest a 1-page pre-read with config snippets + expected token budget to reduce setup friction. I'll draft.

diego: Also adding a small customer pre-check they can run <5m before start:

```
# quick pre-check
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health -d '{"model":"redwood-medium","sample":"hello"}'
```

jess: Good. I'll add a 2-slide rollback reference and a checklist card in the invite.

omar: I'll prepare the notes doc and include an "action owner + due" table. I'll tag anything that looks like a renewal risk with #renewal-risk.

rachel: Scheduler-bot please create invites with recording, shared notes, and a 24h post-session feedback ping.

scheduler-bot: invites created for 2026-02-02T09:00:00-08:00, 2026-02-04T12:30:00-08:00, 2026-02-05T15:00:00-08:00. Notes doc: https://docs.internal/rw/coach-huddles/feb.

felix: For feedback, I propose 4 quick fields: ease(1-5), clarity(1-5), blocker(open), next-step(open). Auto-flag if ease <= 3 or blocker mentions "latency" or "migration".

diego: I'll take Mon notes and slide the perf checklist into the meeting. Jess will do Wed, Omar will do Thu.

jess: If any session surfaces clear technical blockers, route to Solutions immediately and cc AM.

rachel: Final assignments: Mon 09:00 PT = Diego (SE) + Rachel (CS); Wed 12:30 PT = Jess (SE) + Rachel (CS); Thu 15:00 PT = Omar (SE) + Felix (CS). Feedback owner: Felix. Notes owner: Omar (overall doc).

felix: I'll build the simple feedback form and enable 24h reminder. I'll also export a CSV daily for the AMs.

rachel: Nice work team. I'll push the invites and the pre-read by EOD. Please scan the notes doc after the session and mark any #renewal-risk items for a quick follow-up. :rocket:
